say:3:1222511001:1.text: Sinbad! We're back! We have the calming elixir for you!
say:3:1222511001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，我们回来啦！安神药剂做好了！

say:4:1222511002:1.text: Drink it before going to bed. If you drink it during the day, you'll feel super tired and sleepy. Other side effects may occur.
say:4:1222511002:1.source_cn: 记得在睡前喝。要是白天饮用，反而会精神不振哦。

say:5:1222511003:1.text: Wow! We were so busy saving Chippy last time, I didn't get a chance to look at the potion. This one looks beautiful!
say:5:1222511003:1.source_cn: 哇……之前忙着救人，没工夫认真瞧。仔细看看，炼金术做出...

say:6:1222511004:0.text: Hmm... hypothetically, if you were to sell something like this, how much do you think it'll go for?
say:6:1222511004:0.source_cn: 我说……这东西能卖多少钱？

choice_prompt:9:1222511004.text: Hmm... hypothetically, if you were to sell something like this, how much do you think it'll go for?
choice_prompt:9:1222511004.source_cn: 我说……这东西能卖多少钱？

say:10:1222511005:1.text: So just labor costs? How much is it to hire a mage?
say:10:1222511005:1.source_cn: 所以只要付人工费？不过雇佣魔法师又得花多少……

say:11:1222511006:1.text: Never mind, I don't think we can make a lot with this.
say:11:1222511006:1.source_cn: 还是算了，这路数好像捞不到钱。

say:12:1222511011:1.text: Anyway, thanks to you, I'll finally be able to get a good night's sleep.
say:12:1222511011:1.male: Anyway, thanks to you, I'll finally be able to get a good night's sleep.
say:12:1222511011:1.female: Anyway, thanks to you, I'll finally be able to get a good night's sleep.

say:13:1222511012:1.text: You should rest up as well. I've heard you've been running around helping people in the city. Remember to take a break when you can. Look at Chippy. He's starting to look like a ferret with all the weight he lost.
say:13:1222511012:1.source_cn: 你们也悠着点，别整天在城里忙上忙下，该休息就休息。瞧瞧...

say:14:1222511013:0.text: Alright, I got work to do, so I'll see you later.
say:14:1222511013:0.source_cn: 那么——我还有活要干，先走了。回见！

say:18:1222511014:0.text: Hammie, Sinbad said Chippy lost some weight. Is it true?
say:18:1222511014:0.source_cn: 漫漫，你听到了吗，辛巴达说我瘦了！

say:19:1222511015:0.text: Let me see... does your belt feel looser?
say:19:1222511015:0.source_cn: 有吗？让我看看……有觉得腰带变松吗？

say:21:1222511017:1.text: Does your helmet feel like it's sliding off?
say:21:1222511017:1.source_cn: 那，有觉得头盔往下滑吗？

say:24:1222511019:0.text: But Chippy does feel like something has changed! Chippy's sword strikes aren't as fast and powerful as before...
say:24:1222511019:0.source_cn: 但满满真的觉得自己有变化！挥剑没有之前迅捷，力量好像也...

say:25:1222511020:1.text: Perhaps Sinbad is right. We have been really busy these past couple of days.
say:25:1222511020:1.source_cn: 唔……也许辛巴达说得对，我们这段时间确实很忙。

say:26:1222511021:1.text: First, we defeated the Dead Tide Fleet, and then we helped out the Carmine Whispers with their troubles. Not only that, <style="stress"><player_name></style> has been helping people all over Rustport!
say:26:1222511021:1.source_cn: 先是击溃了死潮舰队，又帮助了锈锚港里的帮派。不光如此，...
say:26:1222511021:1.male: First, we defeated the Dead Tide Fleet, and then we helped out the Carmine Whispers with their troubles. Not only that, <style="stress"><player_name></style> has been helping people all over Rustport!
say:26:1222511021:1.female: First, we defeated the Dead Tide Fleet, and then we helped out the Carmine Whispers with their troubles. Not only that, <style="stress"><player_name></style> has been helping people all over Rustport!

choice_prompt:27:1222511021.source_cn: 先是击溃了死潮舰队，又帮助了锈锚港里的帮派。不光如此，城里大大小小的事，<style=stress><player_name></style>都忍不住要伸出援手！
choice_prompt:27:1222511021.male: First, we defeated the Dead Tide Fleet, and then we helped out the Carmine Whispers with their troubles. Not only that, <style="stress"><player_name></style> has been helping people all over Rustport!
choice_prompt:27:1222511021.female: First, we defeated the Dead Tide Fleet, and then we helped out the Carmine Whispers with their troubles. Not only that, <style="stress"><player_name></style> has been helping people all over Rustport!

say:28:1222511022:0.text: Magister, maybe it's time for you to take a break...
say:28:1222511022:0.source_cn: 主人，满满觉得你该放松一下了……
say:28:1222511022:0.male: Magister, maybe it's time for you to take a break...
say:28:1222511022:0.female: Magister, maybe it's time for you to take a break...

say:29:1222511023:1.text: Chippy's right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. How about we go to the <style="highlight">Golden Guest Inn</style> and spend <style="highlight">tonight</style> in one of their VIP rooms?
say:29:1222511023:1.male: Chippy's right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. How about we go to the <style="highlight">Golden Guest Inn</style> and spend <style="highlight">tonight</style> in one of their VIP rooms?
say:29:1222511023:1.female: Chippy's right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. How about we go to the <style="highlight">Golden Guest Inn</style> and spend <style="highlight">tonight</style> in one of their VIP rooms?

say:30:1222511024:1.text: I'm sure the Whispers still have a reservation for us under your name.
say:30:1222511024:1.source_cn: 血薇帮应该还帮我们留着房间。

choice_prompt:32:1222511024.text: I'm sure the Whispers still have a reservation for us under your name.
choice_prompt:32:1222511024.source_cn: 血薇帮应该还帮我们留着房间。

say:33:1222511025:1.text: Alright, let's not worry about anything today and make it as relaxing as possible!
say:33:1222511025:1.source_cn: 嗯，那我们今天就什么都不要管，轻松惬意地度过一天吧！

choice:32:0:1.text: We should take advantage while we can.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 有便宜可占，为什么不呢？
choice:32:0:1.male: We should take advantage while we can.
choice:32:0:1.female: We should take advantage while we can.

choice:32:1:2.text: It's been a while since we had a nice room.
choice:32:1:2.male: It's been a while since we had a nice room.
choice:32:1:2.female: It's been a while since we had a nice room.

choice:27:1:2.text: I do it for the rewards.
choice:27:1:2.male: I do it for the rewards.
choice:27:1:2.female: I do it for the rewards.

choice:9:1:2.text: You want to make money off this?!
choice:9:1:2.male: You want to make money off this?!
choice:9:1:2.female: You want to make money off this?!

say:36:1222511008:1.text: Whoa! That's an insane amount. You know my pockets are emptier than a dead snail's shell.
say:36:1222511008:1.male: Whoa! That's an insane amount. You know my pockets are emptier than a dead snail's shell.
say:36:1222511008:1.female: Whoa! That's an insane amount. You know my pockets are emptier than a dead snail's shell.

say:37:1222511009:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> was just kidding. Although, it is an elixir made by the great Magister Merlin. I'm sure it could sell for a very high price on the potions market.
say:37:1222511009:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> was just kidding. Although, it is an elixir made by the great Magister Merlin. I'm sure it could sell for a very high price on the potions market.
say:37:1222511009:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> was just kidding. Although, it is an elixir made by the great Magister Merlin. I'm sure it could sell for a very high price on the potions market.

say:38:1222511010:1.text: Just be careful handling the magister's gift. If you accidently drop it, there won't be another one.
say:38:1222511010:1.source_cn: 要好好珍惜梅林的赠礼，小心别失手砸碎哦！
say:38:1222511010:1.male: Just be careful handling the magister's gift. If you accidently drop it, there won't be another one.
say:38:1222511010:1.female: Just be careful handling the magister's gift. If you accidently drop it, there won't be another one.

choice:9:2:3.text: Labor costs would be 5 million gold.
choice:9:2:3.male: Labor costs would be 5 million gold.
choice:9:2:3.female: Labor costs would be 5 million gold.
